stages.en: Standing at the top: the 95 g folded glider sits in a holster behind the left hip; reel and 10 Wh cell on the belt. One tap on the belt button arms it.

Push-off: the glider slides out onto the snow and its wings spring open; the reel pays out ~6.5 m, then sled-tows it; at ≥4.5 m/s the reel winches it up to station. Ejection and wing-deploy hardware are illustrative.
Carved turns: the glider flies the smoothed line on slope gravity; the leash holds only ~0.1–0.3 N; the station moves from behind to rear-left.
Highlight: a 6 m/s side gust; the glider crabs, the gimbal keeps the rider framed, the reel absorbs the tension peak.
Station moves to rear-right, then back behind.

Near the lift: a tap (or the lift-base geofence) starts the dock. The rider keeps skiing; the reel draws the glider down the line through the wake into the hip funnel, whose lip folds the wings aft. Seating reliability pending hardware tests.
Stop: the glider is already seated and charging — zero standstill; queue for the lift hands-free.

tensionP95.criterion: ≤3 N (I-05 kill line: above that it is a kite)
